Search CBBIC Home Coastal Bend Business Innovation Center Coastal Bend Business Innovation Center The Innovation Center is a catalyst for innovative ideas, providing business advice for entrepreneurs and supporting the creation of successful, sustainable Coastal Bend businesses at every stage of development.

The Innovation Center plays a major role in promoting cross-disciplinary academic and entrepreneurial programs within the Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi (TAMU-CC) and bringing their benefit to the community.
